title: BoomBros.io - Online Multiplayer Bomberman Clone
author: mantrakid
selftext:
Vibed a (online multiplayer) bomberman clone to play with my friends before robots use my blood as lubricant for their global domination. It's actually a test game for a full multiplayer game engine i built for myself called "Multimate". 

The engine handles all the multiplayer and server bs so i can just focus on pumping out fun multiplayer games to play with my friends before my eyballs are scooped out in the great robot uprising.

Open to questions / critiques / concerns. Except about the fate of mankind. No comment on that.
